overall_summary: Analysis reveals a distinct outlier performance in husband-wife relationship topics, achieving nearly 10x the views of standard shayari or general family content. However, given the small sample size, confidence is moderate, necessitating a controlled focus on relationship dynamics while keeping a small experimentation window.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) significantly outperformed all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on complex, relatable emotional truths within married or long-term romantic relationships.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' performed well with 385 views compared to generic sad shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Focus on unsaid feelings and ego clashes in modern relationships rather than generic heartbreak.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or cliché poetry formats; lean into grounded conversational dialogue.
